g.text: keep every leaf; rebuild siblings with types.Proof
MsgTransfer(current leaf, proof: root R, index i, siblings)
fillProof: omitted top siblings come from the canopy
findRoot(R): is R one of the filled_buffer newest roots?
recompute(leaf, siblings, i) must equal R, else ErrInvalidProof
replay each later changelog: fix the sibling at the critical bit, or take the new leaf if same index
bump: write a new slot (root, path, index), sequence + 1
